title: Czech regional assembly service review – all fourteen regional assemblies

scope.authority: Eligibility inherited only from current inventory; this is a service-source review, not legal re-adjudication.

methodology: Historical eligible validation register used only as route pointers; every row has new 24 October source observations and explicit limits.
Official owned institutional pages and documents are distinguished from search-index text, provider self-designation, player shells, failed requests and actual decoded video.
Web reader can serve cached content; a fresh read attempt does not guarantee current origin content. Source differences and direct-HTTP conflicts are retained.
No result or access failure is not evidence of no stream. No access-control bypass, outreach, credential use or media download performed.
One bounded browser test of Moravia-Silesia archive decoded video; other samples are page evidence only.
Seven per-use rights remain separate; no model licence, institutional publication policy, public URL, website footer or embedded iframe is converted into a blanket AV grant.
Schedules are locally published clock/date strings. Future notices are planned; recording offsets/durations are not broadcast EPG timings. No timezone or stop time invented.
